heat-pump-cost-3-bed-detached.alt: A modern brick detached house on a UK street
heat-pump-cost-3-bed-detached.caption: A 3-bed detached house loses heat through four external walls, which is why it needs a bigger unit than a semi of the same floor area.

heat-pump-noise.query: air source heat pump outdoor unit garden wall
heat-pump-noise.alt: An air source heat pump unit standing beside a house wall
heat-pump-noise.caption: Most of the noise a heat pump makes comes from the fan and the compressor in the outdoor unit, and it is measured at the neighbour's nearest window.

how-long-loft-insulation-lasts.alt: Packs of 170 mm mineral wool loft insulation stacked for sale
how-long-loft-insulation-lasts.caption: Mineral wool, the material in most UK lofts. Kept dry and uncompressed it holds its rated performance for decades.

how-to-improve-epc-rating.query: smart thermostat wall home heating control
how-to-improve-epc-rating.alt: A smart heating thermostat mounted on a wall in a home
how-to-improve-epc-rating.caption: The cheapest EPC points come from controls, lighting and insulation rather than from replacing the heating system.

epc-cost.query: energy performance certificate house survey clipboard
epc-cost.alt: An assessor with a clipboard recording details in an empty room of a house
epc-cost.caption: A domestic energy assessor measures every room, records the construction and heating, and photographs the evidence. The visit takes under an hour.
